findings.summary: The settings file can overwrite the stream's multicast IP address and disable multicast on each open.
The settings file can reset image formation, exposure control, and acquisition modes outside the seven-value profile.
The settings file can disable six triggers outside `FrameStart` and change physical I/O and event settings.
The settings file can replace GigE control and stream recovery settings with values from the save rig.
The settings file can change the file access target and operation selector outside the acquisition profile.
